scope: Review and closeout of WebKit focus fix and local browser/smoke coverage

fixedHarnessFindings: Smoke checked nonexistent PlayerState.paused; now requires actual playing status and Software mode.
A browser startup or cleanup failure could abort the three-browser runner and leave incomplete receipts; now every browser is attempted, cleanup recorded, and all nine cases are required.
Unrecognized BROWSER values silently selected Chromium; component/presentation runners now reject them.
additionalImprovements: Three-browser runner owns an ephemeral server and records runtime/source/fixture identity.
Real video-frame counters and software/hybrid audio-sample counters supplement public state assertions.
Smoke waits for mode selection and records example state; uses decoded file URLs and always closes browser when result writing fails.

uiChecks.reviewOnlyChangesToUISuites: Reject unsupported BROWSER values; both rejection paths checked.

validation.typeScript: Previous full compilation remains valid; production source unchanged during review.

limits: Local browser engines and selected real fixtures, not physical Safari/iOS or packaged release qualification.
Screenshots and intermediate logs remain local; selected JSON receipts are included in the scoped commit.
No long endurance or performance qualification.

git.stateAtValidation: uncommitted; included in subsequent scoped commit
